name: Inequality
overview: Scripture affirms the equal worth of all people as created in God's image, male and female alike, underscoring that God is the Maker of both rich and poor. The New Testament reinforces that God shows no partiality, and in Christ, distinctions such as ethnicity, social status, and gender are transcended, uniting believers as one body. While equality in worth is clear, the Bible also acknowledges distinct roles within the family, as seen in the call for wives to submit to their husbands as to the Lord, reflecting order rather than inequality.
